# Alpha Vantage

> > Alpha Vantage provides free stock, forex, and cryptocurrency APIs in JSON and Excel formats for real-time and historical market data.

Alpha Vantage Inc. is a Y Combinator-backed company headquartered in New York City, offering financial data APIs for quantitative investing, trading agents, and market analysis. The platform includes MCP servers, Alpha Academy educational resources, and both free and premium API access tiers.

## Key Topics

- Alpha Vantage Stock API
- Real-time market data
- Stock market APIs
- Forex data
- Cryptocurrency data
- JSON and Excel formats
- API documentation
- Quantitative investing
- Trading agents
- MCP servers
- Alpha Academy
- API key registration
- Free API access
- Premium membership
- NASDAQ data

## Getting Started

- [Free Stock APIs in JSON & Excel | Alpha Vantage](https://www.alphavantage.co/): Homepage for Alpha Vantage's free stock, forex, crypto APIs and market data
- [Customer Support | Alpha Vantage](https://www.alphavantage.co/support/): Customer support with API key creation, FAQs, and contact information
